hero.kicker: CS + physics · Cal State Long Beach
hero.title: I build software you can open, run, and check.
hero.lede: I study computer science and physics at Cal State Long Beach, with a minor in biology, and I'm working toward MD/PhD training. Most of what I make starts as a research or everyday problem and ends as a small tool with its source in public.

demos.name: RecallWeave
demos.line: A browser-only biology lesson that picks your next question by expected information gain and shows its mastery estimates as you answer.
demos.detail: The learner model is plain Bayesian knowledge tracing with every probability visible; there is no chatbot and nothing leaves the page. Submitted to ForgeHacks 2026 (Devpost entry 1221781).

desktop.alt: RecallWeave on desktop: a question about cellular energy with four answer choices, a concept map, and live mastery bars.

mobile.alt: RecallWeave on a phone after six questions: the learning trace with per-concept mastery estimates.

demos.name: ReturnBy
demos.line: Paste an order-confirmation email and get the return deadline plus a calendar reminder, parsed entirely in your browser.
demos.detail: Rule-based extraction of store, date, order number and total, a per-store return-window table, and an RFC 5545 calendar file with a reminder three days out. Try a sample: the emails are fictional.

desktop.alt: ReturnBy on desktop after loading a sample email: extracted store, order date, order number, total and a 30-day return window.

mobile.alt: ReturnBy on a phone with the same sample email parsed into editable fields.

terminal_demo.name: TowerOps
terminal_demo.tag: AWS Agents for Humans · research simulation
terminal_demo.line: A toy air-traffic scenario where an agent may only propose; deterministic code checks the proposal, a human approves, and every step lands in a hash-chained audit log.
terminal_demo.note: Real output from the repository's demo, trimmed to the fields that tell the story (hashes removed). Synthetic aircraft only; not operational ATC software.

engine_slot.title: Game engine — early render capture
engine_slot.line: Reserved for a labelled capture of the in-progress game engine. It goes up only once a real frame has been rendered and checked.

projects.name: CaptureSuite
projects.line: Windows-first multimodal research capture: a daemon, versioned worker plugins and sealed session packages, with an offline QC demo on synthetic EMG/IMU data.

projects.name: CanvasPilot
projects.line: An MCP server and CLI for Canvas LMS that rides the browser session you already have, for schools that disable personal access tokens.

projects.name: workflow-checks
projects.line: Three small Python checks for back-office paperwork (utility bills, freight detention, PT authorizations), run on synthetic data with file:row evidence.
